card.name: Bandari dance
card.era: traditional; defined regional form late 19th-20th century
card.tagline: Energetic Persian Gulf port dance with African and Arab roots
card.profile: Bandari dance is the same dance as 'bandari' - the Persian Gulf coastal folk dance of Hormozgan, Bushehr and Khuzestan (bandar = port), with African and Arab influences, swaying hip and shoulder movements and hair tossing, performed at weddings and celebrations to 6/8 bandari music (Bandari music, Wikipedia; middleeasterndance.net). See the 'bandari' entry for the full profile.
card.insight: Often called 'Persian belly dance,' though in Iran true belly dance is called raghs-e Arabi; bandari is grounded and group-based, distinct from Egyptian raqs sharqi (danceus.org).
